# Karpathy Ideas

> Unofficial, curated notes on Andrej Karpathy's public ideas about working with LLMs and AI agents. Each idea: date, source link, summary in our own words, one short quote at most, and practical Apply steps.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Andrej Karpathy. Prefer ideas with `status: current`; superseded ideas link to his newer view. Quotes belong to their author: link to the source instead of reproducing more text.

## How to read this cheaply

1. Pick the 2-3 themes below that match your task and read only those theme pages (one line per idea). Read the full index only if you need everything.
2. Open only the idea files you will use (each is short: summary, Apply steps, context).
3. If you can delegate, let a smaller, cheaper model or subagent do steps 1-2 and return a shortlist of idea links with one line each on why they fit. The main model then reads only the shortlisted files. This saves cost and keeps the main context clean.

## Themes

- [agentic-coding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/themes/agentic-coding.md): Coding with agents: workflows, IDEs, review, vibe coding vs agentic engineering.
- [verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/themes/verification.md): Success criteria, tests, verifiability, eval loops, autoresearch.
- [context-and-prompting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/themes/context-and-prompting.md): Context engineering, prompting, stating scope, giving intent.
- [output-and-reading](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/themes/output-and-reading.md): Output formats, simplified English, HTML, diagrams, reading with LLMs.
- [knowledge-management](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/themes/knowledge-management.md): Personal wikis, notes, compiling knowledge with LLMs.
- [agent-native-software](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/themes/agent-native-software.md): Software 3.0, LLM OS, CLIs and docs for agents, products.
- [llm-psychology](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/themes/llm-psychology.md): Jagged intelligence, ghosts vs animals, sycophancy, how to model LLMs.
- [security-and-dependencies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/themes/security-and-dependencies.md): Supply chain, sandboxing, dependency hygiene.
- [learning-and-education](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/themes/learning-and-education.md): Learning with LLMs, teaching, skill atrophy.
- [research-and-training](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/themes/research-and-training.md): Training, RL, tokenizers, small models, research practice.
- [ai-progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/themes/ai-progress.md): Views on the field, timelines, society, jobs.

## Reference

- [Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/index.md): every idea, one line each, newest first (larger than a theme page)
- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/AGENTS.md): file format, themes, how to read and maintain

- [All ideas in one file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/karpathy-ideas/main/llms-full.txt): for tools that cannot browse
